elevate.explanation:
{app} must run elevated.

The panel reads and flushes the network interface and the ARP cache, writes IPs to devices and manages switch ports; none of that can be done reliably with ordinary user privileges.
elevate.manualPosix: You can also start it from a terminal:    sudo python3 app.py
elevate.manualWindows: You can also right-click the application and choose "Run as administrator".
